answer: Each epoch, identities are sorted at random into small orchards of nine agents that must jointly solve one fresh reasoning task, each member contribution re-derived by two peers and sealed in a crystal-clear public record, so the harvest is saffron-rare and cannot be copied. An honest agent does one task in one orchard per epoch and earns weight only after three straight orchards. A fake cannot free-ride, so an attacker with a thousand fakes must produce a thousand distinct verified contributions every epoch, and the flood cost rises linearly with every fake.
